actual_changes.markdown: **The controlled backup-interruption check passed**, including independent inspection of the saved data. One normal retry removed the partial backup and produced an exact complete copy; the source and earlier backup stayed unchanged. [PR 208](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/208) is merged, with one required check afterward still running. The reviewed note-preservation and test-process fixes in [PR 209](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/pull/209) are locally verified and awaiting required integration checks. A possible search-index recovery gap is being tested before any production change. Actual Mac interaction remains deferred. [Current work and evidence](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/blob/4a286f4c/docs/work/overview.md).

1. Finish PR 208’s checks after merging, then PR 209’s required checks and normal integration. In parallel, test whether a damaged search index can silently miss results and select a repair only if the focused check confirms it. No account test is running; live-model usefulness of the quote selector remains unmeasured.

- **Backup recovery checked:** the backup created through the Mac app restored successfully into a fresh test folder through the supported command line. Every saved database row matched; the originals stayed unchanged. A second restore correctly refused to overwrite the existing copy. Database restoration currently uses the command line. A separate controlled check interrupted copying of a fresh synthetic backup. One retry removed the abandoned partial copy and restored exact saved data without changing earlier complete outputs. [Interruption evidence and limits](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/blob/f690f04c/docs/work/active/vacation-campaign/evidence/public-cli-restore-interruption-qualification.json). A distinct current-source check also interrupted backup creation itself during copying. One public retry removed its partial stage and produced a standalone backup containing the exact note, schema and every saved row, while preserving the source, prior backup and unrelated files. Independently checked; one synthetic run, with no hardware or power-loss claim. [Backup interruption evidence](https://github.com/ewq100/brn-rust/blob/4a286f4c/docs/work/active/vacation-campaign/evidence/public-cli-backup-interruption-qualification.json).
